gloss: bouncing back; repelling; deflecting something that comes at you

definitions.gloss: bouncing back; repelling; deflecting something that comes at you
definitions.explanation: Pushing back a force, attack or pressure so that it does not get through, either physically or figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need the strength to deflect criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{逆境|ぎゃっきょう}→逆境：22285_gyakkyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}しで、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: With a comeback from adversity, the team achieved the championship.

notes:
Derived from the compound verb ⟦{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す→跳ね返す：30745_hanekaesu⟧ (to bounce back, to repel). The noun names the act of bouncing something back or repelling it. Water or oil that splashes back is usually ⟦{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}り→跳ね返る：07009_hanekaeru⟧, and a splash guard is a {泥除|どろよ}け (on a vehicle) or a はね⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ — strong rebound/bounce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ — repulsion; rebound (more abstract or scientific)
- ⟦{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す→跳ね返す：30745_hanekaesu⟧ — to bounce back; to repel (the verb form)
